user_acceptance.criterion: Positive mean validation R2 gain under matched confirmation budgets, with improvement in at least two paired seeds.

configuration_selection: Three-seed mean validation MSE; selected inference seed by validation MSE.
presentation: 13 pages, all visually inspected; nine step configurations have strictly increasing validation R2; no text outside page boundaries.
budget_note: 33 seed-42 screening fits capped at 20 epochs; 9 matched three-seed confirmation fits capped at 40. Actual stopping varies; each epoch/update/runtime recorded.
test_policy: Frozen selection before new test evaluation. Historical test exposure acknowledged.
